name: Electronics (KiCad)
description: Look at KiCad schematics and boards, check them for the common mistakes, and export what a board house needs. Info counts what is in a .kicad_sch or .kicad_pcb; Check is a LITE ERC/DRC made by reading the file (KiCad 7's command line has no ERC or DRC: those arrived in KiCad 8): unannotated and duplicate references, parts with no value or footprint, a net label used once, no board outline, parts off the board, tracks under 0.15 mm, vias with a tiny drill; BOM groups parts by value and footprint into a CSV; PDF, Netlist, Gerbers + drill (zipped for a board house) and Placement (pick-and-place) are made by kicad-cli. Run KiCad's own ERC and DRC before you order boards. The files are only read; exports run on a scratch copy.

presets.label: Check (lite ERC / DRC by reading the file)
presets.description: Not KiCad's rule checker: the common mistakes found by reading the schematic or board. Schematic: unannotated (R?) or duplicate references, no value, no footprint, a net label used once. Board: no outline (Edge.Cuts), a part outside the outline, duplicate references, tracks under 0.15 mm, vias with a drill under 0.2 mm.

presets.label: Info: what is in the file
presets.description: Parts or footprints, nets, wires, labels, sheets, copper layers, tracks, vias, zones and the board size.

presets.label: Bill of materials (CSV)
presets.description: Parts grouped by value and footprint: references, quantity, value, footprint, library symbol. Power symbols are left out.

presets.label: PDF of the schematic or board
presets.description: The schematic, or the board (copper, silkscreen, outline), as a PDF through kicad-cli.

presets.label: Netlist
presets.description: The netlist in KiCad's s-expression format (kicad-cli).

presets.label: Gerbers + drill for a board house (zip)
presets.description: Every Gerber layer and the Excellon drill file of a .kicad_pcb in one zip, ready to upload to a board house.

presets.label: Placement file (pick and place, CSV)
presets.description: Reference, value, package, position, rotation and side of every part, in millimetres, for an assembly service.
